paragraphs.text: Alexi was a female Zephyr spellshaper on Jamuraa . She was known for her impressive wielding of rhystic magic.

Alexi was a small but athletic-looking Jamuraan woman with straight black hair. Magical power rushed through her frame. She wore a blue cloak with an intricate black and white checker pattern across the front.

Alexi aided the forces of Barrin and Teferi in the Kipamu League against the Keldons in the Prophecy War . She earned such a reputation among the Keldons that they cursed her, even without knowing her name.
She is possibly an ancestor of Linessa .
